name: CaptureNShare: Capture, Record, Edit & Share
description: Transforms your screen into a canvas—effortlessly record, edit, and share high-quality screenshots and videos like a pro!

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; object-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com https://editor.capturenshare.com; font-src 'self' https://fonts.gstatic.com https://editor.capturenshare.com https://*.capturenshare.com; img-src 'self' data: blob: https://editor.capturenshare.com https://*.capturenshare.com; media-src 'self' blob:; connect-src 'self' http://localhost:3000 https://editor.capturenshare.com https://*.capturenshare.com data: blob:
content_security_policy.sandbox: sandbox allow-scripts; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-eval' data: blob:; object-src 'self' data: blob:
